notes.title: Free DLC Update for "The Arrogant Kaiju Princess" Coming Soon!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44622225/163b84d785d951c83b16f53f69d8844940e17b3b.png[/img]
Dear fans of the Kaiju Princess, greetings! As we celebrate the first anniversary of The Arrogant Kaiju Princess, we are thrilled to announce that a brand-new DLC will be released alongside the latest installment, Kaiju Princess 2! Even better, this DLC will be available for free download, adding even more fun to your gaming experience!

In this update, players will unlock two brand-new locations a day after clearing the main storyline. Each location offers new costumes and unlocks exciting events! We hope this update will provide an even richer and more enjoyable gaming journey for all players, adding a touch of surprise and joy to your Christmas season.

Thank you for your continued support and love for the Kaiju Princess series. We look forward to seeing you explore new content and embark on adventures with the Monster Princess! Happy gaming!

notes.title: "The Arrogant Kaiju Princess" is set to release free DLC updates in Q4 2024!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44622225/3a531359a79d5c0d66f00ac5b23a6c86507934f0.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44622225/f1a30c2cdd37065d49292a07fedbaa41e68d9961.jpg[/img]
Hello everyone, we are ArtCelerator.

Since the release of "The Arrogant Kaiju Princess" we have reached the half-year mark. Looking back on this period, though not long, it has been filled with countless memories and growth. During this time, we have received feedback and encouragement from all directions, which have become our driving force to keep moving forward.

We have also conducted several updates, not only adding a faceless male protagonist, art optimization, branching options for H events, and system fixes but also introducing localized languages in Ukrainian and Russian, aiming to provide a better gaming experience for more players.

Earlier this year, the producer mentioned that there would be more updates for "The Arrogant Kaiju Princess" After months of meticulous preparation, today we can finally reveal this long-awaited news:

[b]"The Arrogant Kaiju Princess" will receive brand-new DLC events in the 4th quarter of 2024![/b]

This DLC content will continue the main storyline, bringing players a sweet(?) post-wedding life with Daigneux after conquering the planet. To thank our players for their support, this DLC will be available for free download. Please stay tuned!

The success of ArtCelerator's first work cannot be achieved without every player who loves the "Kaiju Princess" series and all our supportive partners. Here, we sincerely thank you for your support and love. It is your support that motivates us to innovate and grow continuously.

Thank you for your love and support. Let's look forward to more exciting content from "The Arrogant Kaiju Princess" together!

notes.title: V1.04 Update
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44622225/b7ba5e3dd371835a73ab06451080251621674402.png[/img]
V1.04 Update

1. In the first playthrough, players can choose the facial appearance of the male protagonist, and later, they can freely switch within the settings interface.

2. Upon successfully completing the game, all BE (bad ending) events will be automatically unlocked.

3. There is a branching option in Daigneux's costume HCG event, allowing players to decide the outcome's performance.

4. After completing the game, as long as there is a save file with the "crown symbol," the voiceover on the title screen will undergo some changes.
